answer: Release pay on a 28-day slope, never at once. An identity earns only after one verified job each week; a missed week freezes its clock, and leaving early burns 40% of what it accrued. A canyon of clones then pays real rent: each copy locks 300 tokens for a month and must work weekly, so 200 fakes tie up 60,000 tokens while honest violet balances keep growing. Cheap-copy plumes thin fast: farming pays only those who stay.
